    "def feature_mean(config,selected_subgroups=None):\n",
    "    if selected_subgroups is None:\n",
    "        final_df = {}\n",
    "        for file in config[\"project_files\"]:\n",
    "            df = pd.read_csv(config[\"data_directory\"]+\"/\"+file,header=0,index_col=\"frame\")\n",
    "            final_df[file]=df.mean(axis=0)\n",
    "        final_df=pd.DataFrame(final_df)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        if selected_subgroups==\"all\":\n",
    "            selected_subgroups=list(config[\"subgroups\"].keys())\n",
    "        final_df=[]\n",
    "        for subgroup in selected_subgroups:\n",
    "            group_df = {}\n",
    "            for file in list(config[\"subgroups\"][subgroup]):\n",
    "                df = pd.read_csv(config[\"data_directory\"]+\"/\"+file,header=0,index_col=\"frame\")\n",
    "                group_df[file]=df.mean(axis=0)\n",
    "            group_df=pd.DataFrame(group_df)\n",
    "            group_df.columns = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples([(subgroup, col) for col in group_df.columns])\n",
    "            final_df.append(group_df)\n",
    "        final_df=pd.concat(final_df,axis=1)\n",
    "    return final_df\n",
    "        \n",
    "df = feature_mean(config,selected_subgroups=\"all\")"
